The '''Snowcap Mountain''' was a mountain located in the [[Highmount Ridge]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Snowcap Mountain appears as an area on Hoth in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
